messages:
alex: Heads-up — I started a quick pass on the Vesper-7B model card and the model-catalog entry. Found a couple of gaps: no explicit availability note (regions/tiers), bench links missing from the catalog table, and the seq_limit is absent. Opening PR draft now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :thinking_face:

sam: Nice. Can you paste the seq_limit you want to surface? Also which bench link do you want in the catalog table — the throughput one or the cost/latency matrix?

alex: Seq limit should be 8192 for the tested configs. Add both bench links if possible: throughput (bench/vesper7b/throughput-2026-03-10.html) and cost-latency matrix (bench/vesper7b/cost-latency-2026-03-10.html). I'll update the model card and leave a TODO comment in the catalog yaml for you to add the links.

maya: Quick flag — SDK snippet in the examples uses the old `model: vesper-7b` name and the `timeout_ms` field. We now prefer `model_id: vesper-7b-v1` and `request_timeout_ms`. Should update the example in /docs/examples/vesper-embed.md or CI lint will fail.

alex: Good catch. I'll change the snippet and add a short migration note: "If you upgrade from model name X to X-v1, prefer model_id and adjust request_timeout_ms."

ken: One more product question — is Vesper available on Dedicated? Customers asked whether it falls back to the quantized variant on older runtime versions (2.x). We should add a one-line compatibility note.

sam: For Dedicated we validated on dedicated-gpu-pool-us-west only so far. For runtimes: fallback happens only when serving runtime >= 3.1 supports the quantized kernels; older runtimes will route to the hosted compatible variant per routing policy. Short note like: "Dedicated availability: US-WEST GPU pool (contact sales for other regions). Compatibility: quantized fallback requires runtime >= 3.1."

alex: Perfect — I'll add under "Availability" and "Compatibility" sections.

docs-bot: Lint results for PR #4921 — docs-lint: failed (examples/vesper-embed.md: line 24: deprecated field `timeout_ms`). See https://ci.redwood/4921/logs :x:

maya: I'll fix the snippet and push to the PR branch.

ken: Also add a tiny note in the model-catalog YAML indicating the recommended quant profile: `quant_profile: q4_0` and a link to the quant guidance page. That helps SRE and customers.

alex: Will do. Plan: I will update model card (availability/compatibility/bench links/seq_limit) + add quant_profile. Maya will fix the SDK snippet. Sam will add the bench links into the catalog table and confirm dedicated availability text. Ken will add the short note for runtime fallback in the compatibility blurb.

sam: Can we also add an integration test in docs CI that validates model-catalog entries have bench links and seq_limit? Could be a follow-up issue.

alex: +1. I'll open a follow-up issue after this PR merges.

maya: pushed snippet fix to branch, PTAL @alex (I bumped model_id and replaced timeout_ms). :thumbsup:

alex: Reviewed and merged snippet change into the PR branch. CI will re-run.

docs-bot: CI update for PR #4921 — docs-lint: pass, link-check: warn (one external bench link timed out but reachable via retry).

ken: If the bench link times out, can we host a cached mirror under /bench-archive for the canonical reference?

sam: Let's avoid duplication for now, but add the archive plan to the follow-up issue.

alex: OK — merging once CI is green and sam confirms the catalog table update. Thanks everyone :rocket:
